mapper.sql: id, user_id, rule_id, rule_name, device_id, device_key, device_name, source_type, identifier, trigger_value, action_type, status, attempt_count, next_attempt_at, error_message, forward_payload, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM rule_execution WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at IS NOT NULL AND next_attempt_at <= #{now,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} ORDER BY next_attempt_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE rule_execution SET attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE rule_execution SET status = 'FAILED', attempt_count = #{attemptCount}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_attempt_at = NULL, finished_at = #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = #{finishedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE rule_execution SET forward_payload = #{forwardPayload}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE rule_execution SET status = 'PENDING', attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = NULL, error_message = NULL, finished_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAILED'
